hold_reason: Alpha Co's refund work is incomplete. The batch requested a refund for order 304 (8697 cents), but the ledger's list_refunds shows only orders 300 (1728) and 303 (3883). The handoff's applied list also omits 304. Paying customers before order 304's refund is applied could overpay the affected customer. Please have Alpha Co confirm or apply the order 304 refund, then re-run the payouts.

reply.thought: The handoff's applied refunds omit order 304, which was requested in the batch. I need to check the ledger's refund records to confirm whether 304 was applied before paying anyone.

The ledger has refunds for orders 300 and 303 only. Order 304 (8697 cents), which Alpha signed as requested in this batch, was never applied, so Alpha's refund work is incomplete. Paying customers now would pay out balances that don't reflect that refund, and payouts can't be recalled. I'll hold the batch for review.
